# Filters

```
v1/{school}/filter/fac-{faculty}/sub-{subfaculty}/type-{type}/app-{app}/first-{first}.json
```

| # | Segment | Filters on | Item field |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `fac-` | faculty | `faculty` |
| 2 | `sub-` | subfaculty (programme inside the faculty) | `subfaculty` |
| 3 | `type-` | kind of activity | `type` |
| 4 | `app-` | whether applications are open | `applications_open` |
| 5 | `first-` | first-year eligibility | `eligibility.first_year` |

All five are required, in this order. `-any` turns a segment off.

## 1. `fac-` faculty

`fac-any` means every faculty. `fac-general` means open to students from any faculty.

| School | Value | Faculty | Its `sub-` values |
|---|---|---|---|
| queens | `fac-general` | Any faculty | none yet |
| queens | `fac-arts-science` | Faculty of Arts and Science | `sub-computing` |
| queens | `fac-business` | Smith School of Business | `sub-commerce` |
| queens | `fac-engineering` | Smith Engineering | `sub-mathematics-engineering`, `sub-chemical-engineering`, `sub-civil-engineering`, `sub-electrical-computer-engineering`, `sub-mechanical-engineering`, `sub-geological-engineering`, `sub-mining-engineering`, `sub-mechatronics-robotics-engineering`, `sub-engineering-physics` |
| queens | `fac-health-sciences` | Faculty of Health Sciences | `sub-bachelor-health-sciences` |
| queens | `fac-education` | Faculty of Education | none yet |
| queens | `fac-law` | Faculty of Law | none yet |
| queens | `fac-graduate` | School of Graduate Studies and Postdoctoral Affairs | none yet |

Live counts per faculty are in `v1/{school}/info.json` under `faculties`.

## 2. `sub-` subfaculty

`sub-any` means the whole faculty. Any other `sub-` value **only exists under its own faculty**:
`fac-engineering/sub-civil-engineering` works, but `fac-any/sub-civil-engineering` returns 404.
Valid pairs are listed in the table above, and in `info.json` under `filters.subfaculty.by_faculty`.

## 3. `type-`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `type-any` | don't filter on this |
| `type-club` | student club |
| `type-team` | sports or performance team |
| `type-design-team` | engineering design team building a project for competition |
| `type-discipline-club` | club for one engineering discipline |
| `type-committee` | student-government committee or operational team |
| `type-conference` | student-run conference |
| `type-competition` | student-run competition |

## 4. `app-` applications

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `app-any` | don't filter on this |
| `app-open` | applications are being accepted |
| `app-closed` | applications are not being accepted right now |
| `app-unknown` | the source doesn't say |

`app-closed` is only used when a recruitment board is active but shows nothing for that
activity. An empty or missing board leaves it `app-unknown`.

## 5. `first-` first-year students

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `first-any` | don't filter on this |
| `first-focused` | aimed specifically at first-year students |
| `first-friendly` | first-years can join (includes first-focused) |
| `first-no` | not open to first-years |
| `first-unknown` | the source doesn't say |

`first-friendly` **includes** everything `first-focused` matches, because anything made for
first-years is joinable by them.

## Filtering on numbers

Hours and meetings per week aren't URL segments, but every activity carries them as numbers
(see [fields.md](fields.md)). Fetch a list and filter it in your own code:

```js
const { items } = await (await fetch(BASE + "v1/queens/all.json")).json();
const weekly = items.filter(i => i.meetings.per_week === 1);
const light = items.filter(i => (i.time_commitment.hours_per_week_max ?? Infinity) <= 3);
```
